method: Fellegi–Sunter conditional agreement log-ratio; offline constants only

mU.positive: all generator-declared truth pairs that are candidates, including ambiguous/unrecoverable; eligibility remains separate
mU.negative: all other candidate edges inside the existing date and amount candidate windows

thresholdSelection.selection: first ascending raw score threshold whose validation case-clustered one-sided exact binomial upper bound is <= target; maximize recall by selecting the lowest qualifying threshold
